simple.meaning: קַלַּחַת (qallachath) is a Hebrew word meaning “a kettle.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: קַלַּחַת (H7037) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at 1 Samuel 2:14, with occurrences in 1 Samuel, Micah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to קַלַּחַת (H7037) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in קַלַּחַת (H7037) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: קַלַּחַת (qallachath) / H7037 is traced through 1 Samuel 2:14, Micah 3:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
